1_trend_research.query: Trending viral mysteries, unexplained Indian history, or bizarre biology hooks on YouTube Shorts this week
1_trend_research.rule: Fetch 1 unique topic. Check 'history_log.json' to ensure it was not used in the last 30 uploads.

2_script_generation.hook_formula: Drop viewer directly into an unresolved paradox or shocking claim in first 2 seconds.

output_format.voiceover_clean: Conversational Hindi/Hinglish narration ONLY. No stage directions.
output_format.scene_visual_prompts: 6 distinct prompts (3-4s each), vertical 9:16, 8k, octane 3D render style, dynamic lighting, --no flat color, black screen, static frame

4_video_assembly.captions: Center-aligned, uppercase, 48pt font, yellow active-word highlight, drop-shadow.
